authority.name: Eschmeyer's Catalog of Fishes
authority.method: Queried each CAS/GBIF occurrence name against the searchable Catalog and retained its current-status text, exact query URL and response-text hash. The response text was joined with LF before hashing.
authority.limitation: Name-level crosswalk only. It does not inspect or re-identify the CAS specimen, verify a collection event, establish current presence, or determine fishery relevance. A no-result exact-name query is not evidence of species absence.

taxonChecks.disposition: GBIF and Catalog agree on the accepted combination; preserve the CAS/GBIF source name
hold; current Catalog genus placement conflicts with GBIF Backbone accepted combination; the specimen date also conflicts with its fieldNumber year
name-crosswalk-agrees; this species was already admitted to the internal historical Molawin evidence review

taxonChecks.catalogStatus: No records found for exact Dermogenys vivipara query; the exact Nomorhamphus vivipara query also returned no records.
taxonChecks.disposition: hold; GBIF Backbone mapping is not independently confirmed by the exact Catalog searches

taxonChecks.catalogStatus: The Forster 1801 name is treated as a synonym of Eleotris fusca (Bloch & Schneider 1801); the latter is the valid current combination.
taxonChecks.disposition: hold for source-record name attribution; GBIF flags TAXON_MATCH_FUZZY and the author string differs

taxonChecks.catalogStatus: No records found for exact Ctenogobius criniger or Yongeichthys criniger queries.
taxonChecks.disposition: hold; Backbone combination remains unverified in the current Catalog search

taxonChecks.catalogStatus: No record found for the exact Ophiocara aporos query. The earlier Laguna CAS cross-check maps this source form to Giuris margaritaceus; GBIF uses the differing ending margaritacea.
taxonChecks.disposition: hold; preserve the spelling conflict and do not re-identify the specimen

taxonChecks.catalogStatus: No exact Glossogobius biocellatus entry was found. The current Psammogobius biocellatus entry is valid as that name.
taxonChecks.disposition: partial name-level crosswalk; preserve the original source binomial and do not call this specimen re-identified

taxonChecks.catalogStatus: Valid as Glossogobius celebius (Valenciennes 1837); the page also cites an older synonym treatment under G. giuris.
taxonChecks.disposition: GBIF and current Catalog name treatment agree; retain the recorded name and historical source context

taxonChecks.catalogStatus: No record found for the exact giurus query. The prior Laguna CAS cross-check confirmed the current Catalog treatment Glossogobius giuris and documented giurus as an older usage.
taxonChecks.disposition: name-level crosswalk supported by earlier authority review; not a new specimen identification

decision.reason: The Catalog supports several GBIF combinations but conflicts with or does not resolve other historical names. Keep the CAS scientificName, GBIF acceptedName, authority status and occurrence metadata separate. No record-level identification or current-presence claim follows from a database name crosswalk.
decision.next: Verify selected CAS catalog numbers against the provider's current collection catalog where ordinary access permits; otherwise retain these as GBIF-indexed historical candidates and move to the next independent CALABARZON freshwater source.
